Trim exposure to laggards like ARM and ALAB until volume confirms a reversal. Maintain WATCH overall, but rotate into high-beta tech leaders ahead of Q2 reporting season.

themes: Indonesia's port throughput is structurally rising on coal and nickel export volumes, directly lifting GTSI, PORT, and ELPI regardless of global freight rate swings.

Favor ELPI and PORT for steady cash flows, avoid chasing SAFE's one-day spike. Position into Q3 earnings for tariff-driven transshipment upside.
